compat.unsupportedWebview: Wannan tsarin ba shi da fasalin yanar gizo da Siderkit Break ke buƙata. A macOS, sabunta zuwa 10.15.7 ko sama tare da Safari 15.4+, sannan sake buɗe manhajar.

countdown.done.body: Kirgan minti {minutes} ya ƙare. Ka tashi ka motsa kafaɗunka da wuyanka.
countdown.timerBusy: Da farko ƙare ko dakatar da agogon da ke aiki.
countdown.breakPending: Da farko fara ko watsar da hutun da ke jira.
history.title: Tarihin zama
history.empty: Ba a rubuta wani zama ba tukuna.
history.exportRevealError: Ba a iya buɗe jaka ba.
history.previewError: Ba a iya kirga wannan lokacin ba.
history.exportWarning: Akwai zama {sessions} a wannan lokacin. Fitar da shi na iya ɗaukar ɗan lokaci.
history.exportWarningCritical: Akwai zama {sessions} a wannan lokacin. Littafin aikin zai yi girma kuma yana iya ɗaukar mintuna da yawa.
history.exportConfirmHint: Fitar da manyan bayanai na iya ɗaukar lokaci. Danna kuma don ci gaba.
history.exportError: Ba a iya fitar da tarihi ba.
help.title: Taimako
help.start.title: Fara zaman maida hankali
help.start.body: Danna Fara maida hankali. Za ka iya dakatawa, ci gaba, ƙare zaman, ko watsar da shi daga babbar taga. Ƙare zaman ba ya ƙidaya zuwa dogon hutu.
help.breaks.title: Hutu da dogon hutu
help.breaks.body: Bayan maida hankali ya ƙare, hutu na farawa kai tsaye sai dai idan ka kashe wannan. Dogon hutu yana zuwa bayan wasu zagaye. Dagewa yana motsa hutun minti biyar gaba; tsallakewa yana watsar da shi.
help.countdown.title: Kirga lokaci mai zaman kansa
help.countdown.body: Lokacin da agogon maida hankali ba ya aiki, fara kirga lokaci daga babbar taga. Yana gudana da kansa, ana ajiye shi a tarihi, kuma ba ya taɓa canza zagayen maida hankalinka.
help.overlay.title: Ƙwallon shawagi
help.overlay.body: Ƙwallon shawagi yana zama a saman kuma yana nuna lokacin da ya rage. Zaɓi Nemo ƙwallon shawagi a Saiti ko menu na yankin sanarwa don same shi, ko ja shi don motsa shi.
help.history.title: Tarihi da bayanai
help.history.body: Ana ajiye kowane zama a na'urarka bisa kwanan wata, har da kirga lokaci. Buɗe Tarihi don duba kowane zama ko fitar da kwafin Excel. Manhajar ba ta aika bayanai ko'ina.
help.shortcuts.title: Gajerun hanyoyin madannai
help.shortcuts.body: Fara ko dakatar da maida hankali, ƙare matakin da ke gudana, da nuna ko ɓoye kirga lokaci daga ko'ina ta amfani da gajerun hanyoyin gaba ɗaya.
help.troubleshooting.title: Magance matsala
help.troubleshooting.body: Kirga lokaci na gudana da kansa kuma ba ya canza zagayen maida hankalinka. Idan tunatarwa ba su yin sauti, duba saitunan tunatarwa da fitar da sauti na na'urar. Manhajar tana aiki ba tare da intanet ba.
notification.focus.title: Wannan zagayen ya ƙare
notification.focus.body: Wannan zagayen ya ƙare. Ka rabu da allon, ka duba nesa, ka huta da idanunka.
notification.break.title: Hutun ya ƙare
notification.break.body: Barka da dawowa. Motsa kafaɗunka da wuyanka, ka sha ruwa kaɗan, sannan ka shiga zagaye na gaba a hankali.
notification.welcome.title: Barka da dawowa
notification.welcome.body: Agogonka ya ƙare sa'ad da ba ka nan. Ka sha ruwa kaɗan kafin ka yanke shawara na gaba.
update.available.title: Akwai sabuntawa
update.state.failed: Sabuntawar ta kasa. Duba haɗin intanet ɗinka ka sake gwadawa.
update.state.ready: Sake farawa don kammala sabuntawa zuwa {version}.
update.settings.title: Sabuntawa
update.settings.manual: Sabuntawa kai tsaye suna samuwa a Windows kawai. Zazzage sabuwar sigar daga shafin aikin.
update.settings.metricsHint: Ana aika ID na shigarwa bazuwar, sigar manhaja, da dandamali. Babu asusu, amfani, ko bayanan sirri.

insights.tagsEmpty: Babu zama mai alama a wannan lokacin.
insights.emptyBody: Fara zagayen maida hankali kuma lokacinka zai bayyana a nan.
insights.error: Ba a iya loda bincike ba.
settings.rhythm.title: Gudun aiki da agogo
settings.restoreBody: Duk saituna za su koma ga asalin su. Tarihin zama da alamu za su kasance.

settings.overlay.locateHint: Yana haskaka firam a kewayen taga.
settings.overlay.resetHint: Yana mayar da taga zuwa kusurwar asali.
settings.notifications.enabledHint: Yana nuna kati lokacin da maida hankali ko hutu ya ƙare.
settings.notifications.tickHint: Yana ƙara kawai yayin maida hankali, ba lokacin hutu ba.
settings.notifications.errorTooLarge: Wannan fayil ɗin sauti ya fi MB 2 girma.
settings.notifications.errorTooLong: Wannan fayil ɗin sauti ya fi daƙiƙa 5 tsawo.
settings.notifications.errorUnreadable: Wannan fayil ɗin ba sautin da manhajar za ta iya kunna ba.
settings.data.title: Bayanai da sirri
settings.data.clearHint: Yana goge kowane zama da alama. Saituna suna kasancewa yadda suke.
settings.data.clearBody: Ana goge kowane zama da alama har abada. Ba a canza saituna.
settings.diagnostics.title: Bayanan bincike
settings.diagnostics.copyError: Ba a iya kwafa ba. Zaɓi rubutun da hannu.
settings.diagnostics.clearBody: Rikodi suna taimakawa wajen bayyana matsaloli. Manhajar za ta rubuta sababbi bayan wannan.
settings.diagnostics.caption: Yana kwafin sigar manhaja, tsarin, WebView, harshe, jigo, da sabbin gargadi. Ba a taɓa haɗa bayanan zama da alamu ba.
settings.about.caption: Na gida: zama da alamu suna kan wannan na'urar.
